{{Quote|Forgive me. I feel it again. The pull to the light. The Supreme Leader senses it. Show me again, the power of the darkness, and I will let nothing stand in our way. Show me, grandfather… and I will finish what you started.|Kylo Ren|<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>}}
'''''Star Wars: Legacy of Vader''''', or '''''Star Wars: The Legacy of Vader''''', alternatively titled '''''Star Wars: Legacy of Vader – The Reign of Kylo Ren''''', is a [[canon]] [[2025]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Luke Ross]]. The series focuses on [[First Order]] [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and takes place right between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. The [[Legacy of Vader 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[February 5]], 2025.
